column1: # P-01: the PRD performance targets as limits a run can be held to. `make perf-gate` reads this file.
# Columns, separated by TABs: scenario, interval (a name in the run log), statistic (p50 p95 max peak), limit, PRD row, folder.
#   A scenario with a folder runs once per folder: "open" without one is the folder under test, "open" with scan-5000 the scan test.
#   A value passes when it is at or under the limit. The gate value is the median of the scenario's runs.
#   limit "-" : the row is printed but cannot fail.   folder (optional): a bench folder name; else the folder under test.
#   scenario "launch": scripts/launch-time.sh, not an in-app scenario. A "-slow" scenario is its base scenario with a loader delay of 200 ms (G-11).
#   Display-frame rows use 16.7 ms, one refresh at 60 Hz; P-05 decides what counts as "within one frame" for a key that arrives mid-frame.
